content.scenario: A consumer in Mumbai has obtained an order from the District Commission against a company for defective goods. The company has not complied with the order, and the consumer wants to enforce it.
content.outcome: The District Commission will enforce the order in the same manner as a decree made by a Court in a suit, as per the provisions of Order XXI of the First Schedule to the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. The consumer can approach the District Commission to initiate the enforcement process.
